compliance.settlement_party: Fair Share Housing Center (FSHC); mediation agreement

notes: Saddle Brook's Fourth Round DCA obligation: Present Need (Rehabilitation) = 42, Prospective Need = 279. VLA analysis shows no additional vacant land, but as part of mediation with FSHC the Township agreed to RDP of 17, resulting in unmet need of 262. Two new Round 4 overlay sites: (1) Midland Ave-Van Bussum Overlay on Block 401 (Lots 1, 2.01, 2.02, 3, 4, 5; 3.77 acres; >=220 units; 20% set-aside; developer: Maxim Realty Trust/Midland Commons of Saddlebrook LLC); (2) 580 North Midland Ave (Block 1710, Lot 38; 0.74 acres) with two alternative overlays - supportive housing (10 units, 100% affordable) OR age-restricted rental (12 units, 3 affordable/25% set-aside). Prior round sites (Mayhill Apts Block 910 Lot 2; Midland Commons Block 402 Lots 1&2; AH-5 Block 1401 Lots 4&5; Senior Housing Block 408 Lot 8; Saddle Brook 100% Affordable Block 1401 Lot 18; CARING Inc Block 703 Lot 31; Legregni St Block 511 Lot 19.20) are credit sources for prior rounds. CORRECTION: Candidate snapshot said Block 1710, Lot 38 = 10-unit supportive 100% affordable separately from 12-unit age-restricted but combined as same AHOZ - HEFSP confirms both overlays apply to same parcel Block 1710, Lot 38 (not Lot 28 as listed in HEFSP summary bullets - Lot 38 confirmed by site description and map). Also CORRECTION: candidate listed Block 401 as 'AHOZ-6' with lots '1, 2.01, 2.02, 3, 4, 5' - HEFSP calls it 'Midland Avenue-Van Bussum Overlay' not AHOZ-6. And the 25% set-aside for the age-restricted site should be read as 20% (not 25%) per the HEFSP text: 'not less than 20% (3 of the 12 units)'.

sources.title: Township of Saddle Brook Fourth Round HEFSP Amended, Adopted March 13, 2026
sources.excerpt: The DCA calculated Saddle Brook Township's Present Need (Rehabilitation) Obligation as 42 units and its Fourth Round Prospective Need Obligation as 279 units...the realistic development potential for the Fourth Round has been amended to 17 as part of the Township's Mediation Agreement with FSHC.

sites.address: Midland Avenue & Van Bussum Avenue, Saddle Brook, NJ
sites.developer: Maxim Realty Trust / Midland Commons of Saddlebrook LLC
sites.quote: Maxim Realty Trust, the principal company of Midland Commons of Saddlebrook, LLC, has assembled 3.77 acres comprised of Lots 1, 2.01, 2.02, 3, 4, and 5 in Block 401 for a proposed inclusionary housing development. The Township will adopt an overlay zone for the assemblage of properties to allow for the construction of a multi-family inclusionary development of not less than 220 total units, inclusive of a 20% affordable housing set-aside, resulting in 44 affordable housing units assuming all 220 units are constructed.
sites.notes: Round 4 Fourth Round compliance mechanism. Developer Maxim Realty Trust has assembled 3.77 acres. The HEFSP map caption confirms 'BLOCK 401, LOTS 1, 2.02, 2.02, 3, 4, 5'. Adjacent to existing Grande at Saddle Brook (60-unit inclusionary development). Candidate snapshot called this 'AHOZ-6' - the HEFSP refers to it as 'Midland Avenue-Van Bussum Overlay'. Max 5 stories/65 ft per candidate snapshot Ord 1797-26 reference; confirmed 20% set-aside.

sites.site_name: 580 North Midland Ave - Supportive Housing Overlay (Block 1710, Lot 38)
sites.address: 580 North Midland Avenue, Saddle Brook, NJ
sites.quote: The Township of Saddle Brook entered into a Mediation Agreement with 580 North Midland, LLC and agreed to rezone the property at 580 North Midland Avenue with two separate overlay zone districts...The property is a 0.74-acre parcel known as Lot 38 in Block 1710...The first overlay zone will permit the construction of a supportive independent living housing development for disabled individuals...which will be comprised of 10 one-bedroom apartments.
sites.notes: CORRECTION: HEFSP summary bullets (p.25) say 'Block 1710, Lot 28' but the actual mediation agreement description on p.40 and map caption say 'Lot 38 in Block 1710' / 'BLOCK 1710, LOT 38'. Lot 38 is correct. The two overlays (supportive housing and age-restricted) apply to the same parcel - only one will be built. 100% deed-restricted affordable units for disabled individuals with State of NJ visiting services.

sites.site_name: 580 North Midland Ave - Age-Restricted Inclusionary Overlay (Block 1710, Lot 38)
sites.address: 580 North Midland Avenue, Saddle Brook, NJ
sites.quote: The second overlay shall allow for the development of a structure to include 12 one-bedroom age-restricted rental units. Not less than 20% (3 of the 12 units) of the units shall be deed restricted as affordable housing units and shall be UHAC compliant.
sites.notes: Alternative overlay on same parcel (Block 1710, Lot 38) as supportive housing overlay - only one will be built. The HEFSP states '20%' as the set-aside; the parenthetical '3 of the 12 units' is rounding up from 2.4 (20% x 12). UHAC compliant. Same lot discrepancy as supportive overlay (summary says Lot 28, detailed text says Lot 38).

sites.quote: The Mayhill Apartments are located at 140 Mayhill Street (Block 910, Lot 2). The complex consists of 156 one- and two-bedroom units, 15 of which are affordable family rental units.
sites.notes: Prior Round credit site (Rounds 1-3). 15 affordable family rental units + 15 rental bonus credits = 30 total credits. Deemed credit worthy in Third Round Judgment of Compliance and Repose.
